questions.prompt: Which approach best applies activitythread.main and application binding?
options: Model ActivityThread as the main-process coordinator and keep bind-time provider and Application work minimal and failure-safe.
questions.answer: Model ActivityThread as the main-process coordinator and keep bind-time provider and Application work minimal and failure-safe.
questions.explanation: This answer keeps the ownership boundaries distinct and requires version-matched evidence, failure testing, compatibility, and operational follow-through.

questions.prompt: Each Activity instance receives its own dedicated ActivityThread and Looper.
questions.explanation: The class name ActivityThread often leads learners to claim it creates a separate thread per Activity, which is not its role.

questions.prompt: What happens before the main Looper begins handling normal component transactions?
questions.answer: The process enters ActivityThread.main, prepares the main Looper, attaches to system services, and receives application binding work.
questions.explanation: The answer identifies the mechanism and owner that make the explanation causal rather than a memorised sequence.
